item.title: FilmDoo
item.description: FilmDoo is a global edutainment platform and technologies company helping people to learn languages and explore cultures through film, TV and short-form content.

item.title: TVN Discovery Group
item.description: TVN Discovery Group is the leading broadcaster in Poland and is part of Discovery, Inc. It currently operates 24 channel brands, including free-to-air networks and a variety of factual, lifestyle, news, sports, film and pay-TV brands.

item.title: Warner Bros. Discovery
item.description: Discovery is a global leader in real life entertainment, serving a passionate audience of superfans around the world with content that inspires, informs and entertains.

item.title: Sooner
item.description: Sooner is a video-on-demand streaming service from the Franco-German joint venture ContentScope. The joint venture's shareholders are Metropolitan Film Export of Paris and EYZ Media of Berlin.

item.title: Chili
item.description: CHILI is a European Entertainment Company, located in Milan. Thanks to the success achieved in Italy, it has expanded to the UK, Germany, Poland, and Austria.

item.title: Roku
item.description: Roku pioneered streaming to the TV, helping usher in a boom in the creation of hundreds of new movies and television shows over the last two decades with its purpose-built TV operating system.

item.title: ARD Plus
item.description: ARD Plus is a German commercial streaming service with a large selection of content that is no longer available in the ARD media library. Highlights from 70 years of ARD TV history are reunited and revived.

item.title: NBC Universal International
item.description: NBCUniversal is one of the world’s leading media and entertainment companies in the development, production, and marketing of entertainment, news and information to a global audience.

item.title: The Walt Disney Company
item.description: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Parks, Experiences and Products.

item.title: SkyShowtime
item.description: SkyShowtime is a joint venture of Comcast and Paramount Global bringing together the best of Hollywood and local entertainment in one place. From movies to original series, SkyShowtime is Europe’s home for premium entertainment.
